name: production: the Runner Quest card is in the game library (flag on) next to the six original games
tapping the card opens the Control screen (existing staff gate passed)
child name prefilled from the selected patient
the production build has no simulator and no development hooks
sensor modes are offered but labelled experimental; MANUAL is the default
Display (other device) shows the ready screen from Firebase
touch START -> playing on both devices
touch LEFT is accepted by Control and reaches the Display
with no input the runner waits at an obstacle; session stays playing (no failure)
touch SKIP -> stage complete on both
END opens the platform's end-reason sheet (production flow)
ended: summary on Control and on the Display
one Runner Quest history record saved with the end reason, no accuracy fields
no console exceptions on either device
